<!-- generated by FlowCast Studio from https://wso2.com/integration-platform/docs/connectors/catalog/erp-business/microsoft.dynamics365.finance.procurement/example -->

## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `Example`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `microsoft-dynamics365-finance-procuremen`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **Example**.

## Step 2: Open the connector palette

1. Select **Add Connection** in the **Connections** section.

## Step 3: Select the Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance Procurement connector

1. Search for `microsoft.dynamics365.finance.procurement`.
2. Select **Procurement** connector.

## Step 4: Bind the connection parameters to configurable variables

1. Select **auth** within **Config** to reveal its fields, then enable the optional **tokenUrl** field alongside the required **clientId** and **clientSecret** fields.
2. <!-- manual: Switch Config to Expression mode and enter the record {auth: {tokenUrl, clientId, clientSecret, scopes}}. -->
3. Open the helper panel for **Service Url**, select **Configurables** tab, and create a new configurable named `serviceUrl`.

## Step 5: Save the connection

1. Select **Save Connection** and verify that **procurementClient** appears in the **Connections** section.

## Step 6: Set actual values for your configurables

1. Select **Configurations** at the bottom of the project tree under **Data Mappers**.
2. Run the shell command `.venv/bin/python tools/write_config.py --project microsoft-dynamics365-finance-procuremen --expect tokenUrl,clientId,clientSecret,scopes,serviceUrl` to set the configurable values.

## Step 7: Add an automation entry point

1. Select **Add Entry Point** next to **Entry Points**.
2. Select **Automation**.
3. Select **Create** to accept the settings.

## Step 8: Expand the connection and configure the List Delivery Terms operation

1. <!-- manual: Select the add icon on the automation flow to open the node panel. -->
2. Select **procurementClient**.
3. Select **List Delivery Terms**. This operation has no required parameters, so review the default result variable.
4. Select **Save**.

## Step 9: Log the List Delivery Terms result

1. <!-- manual: Select the add icon on the connecting line between the operation and Error Handler. -->
2. Select **Logging**.
3. <!-- manual: Switch Msg to Expression mode and enter procurementDeliverytermscollection.toJsonString(). -->
4. Select **Save**.
